summary: Challenge to 2016 demonetization notification; validity under Section 26(2) of RBI Act; interpretation of 'any' in statutory provision; delegation of legislative power; scope of judicial review in economic policy; proportionality test applied; RBI's recommendation examined; constitutional challenges under Articles 14, 19, 21, 300A; maintainability of writ petitions; harmonious construction of 2017 Act; impugned notification upheld.
legal_provisions_cited: Reserve Bank of India Act, 1934 s.26(2)
Reserve Bank of India Act, 1934 s.7
Reserve Bank of India Act, 1934 s.17

final_judgment: Challenge to demonetization policy dismissed; impugned notification upheld; petition dismissed.
